html:
Grok Bot has completely broken my brain.

I got an insane amount of work done today.

But I genuinely feel like I did nothing.

Because I barely DID any of it.

I just told my AI team what needed to happen...

and it happened.

This is such a weird new version of work. pic.twitter.com/P23OSYbyPL

— Liam (@liam_fallen) August 19, 2026
